card.name: Storm after thyroid; symptoms after until
card.fires_on: The word "storm" right after "thyroid" (thyroid storm), and "symptom(s)" right after "until" in instructions to hold a drug until symptoms resolve.

modes.label: Thyroid storm
modes.description: The word storm directly after thyroid, in warnings about hyperthyroidism or stopping beta-blockers.
modes.example: Thyroid<< storm>> has occurred following the intravascular use

modes.label: Until symptoms resolve
modes.description: Symptom or symptoms right after "until" in dose-hold instructions.
modes.example: Interrupt until<< symptoms>> resolve and diastolic blood pressure less
